{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true outcomes when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.5), with average bias of ~1.5-2.0 points",
    "Model forecasts overshoot downward when sentiment turns negative, lagging behind true price reversals by 1-2 days",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative causes model to underperform as it remains too long",
    "When price is in a clear downtrend, model forecasts are too high by 1-3 points (mean reversion bias)",
    "Strong positive sentiment (sentiment = 1.00) correlates with highest model error, averaging 2-3 points below reality",
    "Model fails to fully capture sentiment-induced price rebounds, especially when sentiment transitions from negative to neutral/positive",
    "The bias magnitude correlates with sentiment intensity, with extreme sentiment values producing largest forecast errors"
] }
